inheritance: Frozen v1 runtime validates and calculates unchanged engines; successor replaces only cash flow, debt ratio, liquidity horizon, education separation and protection-scope results
netIncome: NET streams unchanged; GROSS streams require an explicit tax assumption; unspecified basis remains unknown
debtService: Explicit expense-liability links deduplicate; unmatched liability repayments are included; ambiguous or conflicting links return unknown
education: Each open education goal has independent result/trace; a multi-goal household summary remains unknown rather than selecting the first goal or double-allocating funding
protection: Policy declarations remain separate; a household coverage gap stays unknown until insured-person, risk-event and needs-model authority are bound
tracePolicy: Existing input/assumption references retained; snapshot and calculation digests independently recomputed
